title: OFFICIAL NOTICE convening the Extraordinary General Assembly of the members of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova
body_html:
Dear members of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova,

We hereby inform you that an Extraordinary General Assembly of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova has been convened for 18 May 2025, at the following address:

12A Bucuriei St., Chișinău, starting at 12:00.

The General Assembly is convened in accordance with the Federation’s Statute and on the basis of a submitted initiative meeting the established requirements, in order to examine matters of major importance for the Federation’s activity.

Agenda of the Extraordinary General Assembly:

1. Examination of the early termination of the mandate of the incumbent President of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova, Mr Ion SARANDI, appointed to this position under the minutes of the General Assembly of 11.06.2022.

2. Election of a new President of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova for a 4-year term.

3. Examination of the dissolution and early termination of the mandate of the current Bureau of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova, constituted under the minutes of the General Assembly of 29.12.2019.

4. Election of the members of the Administrative Council (Bureau) of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova for a 4-year term.

5. Examination of amendments and additions to, and registration of a new version of, the Statute of the Table Tennis Federation of the Republic of Moldova.

All members of the Federation are asked to attend in person or through duly authorised representatives, in accordance with the Statute and the legislation in force.

This notice is published on the official website of the National Sports Association ATTP in order to inform all members properly and is deemed officially communicated to the parties concerned from the moment of its publication.

Yours faithfully,

Oleg DOBRJINSCHI

Representative of the authorised body

convening the General Assembly

(1/3 of the total number of Federation members)
